title: Downsample
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Operations/Downsample.md
text: Resample input at lower rate by deleting samples, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial conditions} sets Initial value; {Downsample factor source} sets the source of downsample factor, {Downsample factor, M} sets the downsampling factor, {Sample offset (0 to M−1)}, {Input processing} sets the method to process input Columns, {Rate options} sets the enforce single-rate or allow multirate processing Enforce single-rate and {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}. Values come from the instance.
